mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_object (id, workspace_id, kind, title, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{kind}, #{title}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, kind, title, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_knowledge_object WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM ainer_knowledge_object WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_revision (id, object_id, revision_number, payload_markdown, status, created_by_issuer, created_by_type, created_by_id, created_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectId}, #{revisionNumber}, #{payloadMarkdown}, #{status}, #{createdByIssuer}, #{createdByType}, #{createdById}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_source (id, revision_id, source_type, source_ref) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{revisionId}, #{row.sourceType}, #{row.sourceRef})

INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_evidence (id, revision_id, link_type, target_ref) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{revisionId}, #{row.linkType}, #{row.targetRef})
mapper.select: SELECT id, revision_id, source_type, source_ref FROM ainer_knowledge_source WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, revision_id, link_type, target_ref FROM ainer_knowledge_evidence WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY id
SELECT max(revision_number) FROM ainer_knowledge_revision WHERE object_id = #{objectId}

SELECT id, object_id, revision_number, payload_markdown, status, created_by_issuer, created_by_type, created_by_id, created_at, published_at FROM ainer_knowledge_revision WHERE object_id = #{objectId} ORDER BY revision_number

SELECT id, object_id, revision_number, payload_markdown, status, created_by_issuer, created_by_type, created_by_id, created_at, published_at FROM ainer_knowledge_revision WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at <= #{asOf} ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_revision_lineage (from_revision_id, to_revision_id, relation, created_at) VALUES (#{from}, #{to}, 'SUPERSEDES', #{at})

INSERT INTO ainer_knowledge_lifecycle_event (id, object_id, revision_id, event, actor_issuer, actor_type, actor_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectId}, #{revisionId}, #{event}, #{actorIssuer}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ainer_knowledge_lifecycle_event WHERE object_id = #{objectId}
